Class SilBuffer

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.rl.SilBuffer
public final class SilBuffer extends Object
Self-imitation learning (Oh et al., 2018): the steps that went far better than the critic expected, kept to be learned from again after the update that first saw them. On-policy PPO learns from a step once and throws it away, so a fight it wins once in ten against an opponent it cannot yet beat moves it about as much as the nine it loses, and what won it is gone by the next update. Kept here, such steps are imitated (their action made likelier) for as long as the critic still expects less than they brought, and no longer: once it has learned them, they no longer pull. See Ppo.selfImitate and Config.silWeight.

A ring of the most recent such steps; each holds what the actor and the critic need again.
